device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

final_actual_cuda.scope: solid, WCSPH, CSR bridge, package layering, curvature and SDF tests

broader_cpu.scope: pre-existing mesh3d, curvature/SDF and visualizer work

limitations: Prepared pair rates exclude search, preparation, assembly and readback.
CUDA properties are register/local-memory properties, not newly measured achieved occupancy or FLOP counters.
Pipeline memory is owned array capacity, not peak driver memory.
Convenience bridge returns CSR to host and uploads pair arrays; it is not GPU-resident preparation.
Static nonoverlapping volume meshes only; no BoundaryProvider wiring or fluid-solver behavior validation.
Optional tensile shifting and Morris viscosity are not supplied by these bundles.
